findings: RenameFolderDialog passes its complete content through the trailing AppDialog buttons RowScope slot, nesting a full Column inside the action row rather than title/text slots. Actual layout/width behavior remains unrendered.

Rename input is remembered without currentFolderName key, so reusing the composition for a different folder can retain prior input. Confirmation rejects only blank/unchanged names; slash and filesystem checks are deferred to FileOperationsHelper.
Rename component has no error/in-progress state or disabled-during-submit guard. Whether caller closes immediately or handles failures remains unread.

AppDialog optional title/text and buttons use a non-scrolling Column; long caller content may exceed available height. Dont ask again label is hardcoded English. No rendered overflow or accessibility test claimed.
SheetItemCard uses URI image loading with crop and no filename inside this component, as documented; list labels are delegated to parent. No new duplicate-matching behavior here.
